name: text-loop

frames.best_why: Both ribbons are visible at full width with the bold white words clearly riding the blue wave.

tagline: Two crossing purple ribbons carry looping white text along a wave.
summary: Uppercase words and star separators run endlessly along a thick wavy ribbon, with a second pale ribbon crossing it at an angle. The text loops without a seam and slows when hovered.
appearance: A wide dark band with a vivid blue-violet ribbon and a pale lavender ribbon crossing in opposite diagonals, both following a wave. Bold uppercase white letters with star separators ride the ribbons.
behaviour: The words slide along both ribbons in opposite directions, wrapping with no visible seam. Hovering eases the movement to a stop, and with dragging enabled the strip can be pulled and flung.
demo_content: Uppercase "Design systems ✦ Motion ✦ Interfaces" repeated along the ribbons.
use_when: A hero or divider needs a wide moving band of repeated words to add energy without images.
avoid_when: Constant motion cannot be paused except on hover, and long uppercase text can feel loud on quiet pages.
customise: Text, shape or custom SVG path, speed, direction, separator, font size, colours, ribbon width, edge fade, cross ribbon and dragging are props.
weight_why: A ticker moves two text paths; no layout or canvas work.

a11y.note: The strip is a labelled image with no pause button or keyboard control; motion stops under reduced motion.

polish_why: High-impact crossing ribbons; cut-off letters at the edges look accidental without a fade.
title: Text Loop
